item.title: OrcaSlicer vs PrusaSlicer vs Cura in 2026: Which Open-Source Slicer Should You Actually Use?
item.description: The slicer is the single most consequential piece of software in a 3D printing workflow, and it is also the one people change least often — usually because switching means rebuilding every filament profile they have tuned over two years. That is a bad reason to stay on the wrong slicer in 2026, when the three serious open-source options have diverged more sharply than at any point since Slic3r.
